Micro Kingdom MK666 Wireless Keyboard and Mouse Combo Black (Full-Size Wireless Layout / 2.4GHz USB Receiver Connection / Ergonomic Optical Mouse / Silent Membrane Keys / Long Battery Life / Plug & Play Setup)

Streamline your workspace and remove cable clutter with the Micro Kingdom MK666 Wireless Keyboard and Mouse Combo in Black, available at Turbo Computer Egypt. This sleek wireless desktop combo features a full-size membrane keyboard with responsive keys, an ergonomic optical mouse for smooth tracking, a shared 2.4GHz nano USB receiver for effortless plug-and-play connectivity, and optimized power saving for extended battery life.
